scripts.guard:dist: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs=>{const bad=[];const walk=p=>{for(const e of fs.readdirSync(p,{withFileTypes:true})){const f=p+'/'+e.name;if(e.isDirectory()) walk(f); else if(f.endsWith('.ts') && !f.endsWith('.d.ts')) bad.push(f);} }; walk('dist'); if(bad.length){console.error('dist contains .ts files:', bad.join(',')); process.exit(1);} })"
scripts.test:contract: npm run build && node dist/cli.js run examples/demo.csl out/test_contract.json && node -e "const j=require('fs').readFileSync('out/test_contract.json','utf8'); const o=JSON.parse(j); const p=o.final?.phi||{}; const k=['PI','SQRT2','SQRT3','PHI','LN5']; for(const kk of k){ if(!(kk in p)) throw new Error('missing '+kk); const v=Number(p[kk]); if(!Number.isFinite(v)) throw new Error('non-finite '+kk); } console.log('OK contract');"
